name: Sentmenat (Spain)
description: Red field with three white billets, each charged with a blue wing, set two and one at the optical centre.
history: The flag was published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya on 19 October 1990; it is an oblong flag of 2:3, red, with three white billets each charged with a blue wing, in the same arrangement as in the arms (two above and one below), placed at the optical centre with their axis at 4/9 from the hoist; the wings are the arms of the Sentmenat family, lords of the castle.
